grants.title: Tilskudd til friluftslivsaktivitet
grants.amount_note: The grant page gives no maximum amount. Ask the grant provider if 60000 NOK is realistic.
grants.why_qualifies: Your club is a voluntary membership organisation working with outdoor life. Free hiking, campfire and canoe days for children are organised friluftsliv activities that increase participation, which is what the grant supports.
attachments: The grant page lists no required attachments. Check the application form for what to upload.
steps: Open the application portal of Miljødirektoratet from the grant page.
Describe the outdoor activity days for children aged 6-12 in Hamar.
Enter the requested amount of 60000 NOK and a simple budget.
Send one application only, even if you list several activities.
Confirm the deadline on the grant page before applying.
